 Common Judgment

The petitioners have filed these respective claim petitions in
Mvc 862/2018 & 663/2018 as against the respondents U/S. 166 of
Motor Vehicles Act for seeking compensation of Rs.20,00,000/-
and Rs.10,00,000/- each for the injuries sustained by them in a
road traffic accident.

All these petitions are arising out of the same accident,
hence, these petitions are clubbed and taken together for common
discussion.
3. The brief contents of both the petitions are as under:

The allegation of the petitioners is that, on 2.8.2017 at
about 5.30 p.m. the petitioners were proceeding in a car bearing
No.KA-05-AF-0140, the said car was driven by the petitioner in
Mvc 862/2018 on the extreme left side of the road, near
Bairaveshwaranagar, 4th Main road junction slowly and cautiously by
following all the traffic rules and regulations, at that point of time
one tractor and trailer bearing No.KA-13-TA-1827 and Ka-36-Ta-
6183 driven by its driver in a rash and negligent manner so as to
endanger human life and safety of others dashed against the
petitioners.

Due to the said impact, the petitioners fell down and

sustained grievous injuries.

Immediately they were shifted to
Dhanush Hospital, wherein they were admitted as an inpatient.

4. The contention of the petitioner in MVC.No.862/2018 is
that, he was hale and healthy at the time of accident, aged about
26 years, working as a driver and earning a sum of Rs.15,000/- per
month.
After the accident, he could not do the work as earlier.

5. The contention of the petitioner in MVC.No.863/2018 is
that, she was hale and healthy at the time of accident, aged about
23 years, tailor and earning a sum of Rs.15,000/- per month.

Due to
the accidental injuries, she could not do the work as earlier.

6. The contention of the petitioners is that, the accident
occurred due to the negligent driving of the driver of the tractor
and trailer bearing No.KA-13-TA-1827 and Ka-36-Ta-6183.

So,
the respondents are jointly and severally liable to pay compensation
to the petitioners.

Contending the above facts, the petitioners
have filed these respective claim petitions and pray to grant for
compensation with interest and cost.

7 . In response to the petition notice, the respondents have
not appeared before the court, placed exparte.

8 . In order to prove their case, petitioners in Mvc 862/2018
& 863/2018 are examined as Pw1 and Pw2 got marked

the
documents as Ex.P1 to P9 and Medical Record Officer is examined
as Pw3 and got marked the documents at Ex.P10 to Ex.P14.

 grievous injuries in an accident that was occurred
 due to rash and negligent driving of the driver of
 the tractor and trailer bearing No.KA-13-TA-1827
 and Ka-36-Ta-6183 on 2.8.2017 at about 5.30 p.m.
 near Bairaveshwaranagar 4th Main Road Junction,
 Bengaluru?

2. Whether the petitioner is entitled for compensation
 as prayed for?
If so, at what rate?

From whom?
 3. What order or award?

Motor Vehicles Act for seeking compensation of Rs.20,00,000/-
and Rs.10,00,000/- each for the injuries sustained by them in a
road traffic accident.
The allegation of the petitioners is that, on 2.8.2017 at
about 5.30 p.m. the petitioners were proceeding in a car bearing
No.KA-05-AF-0140, the said car was driven by the petitioner in
Mvc 862/2018 on the extreme left side of the road, near
Bairaveshwaranagar, 4th Main road junction slowly and cautiously by
following all the traffic rules and regulations, at that point of time
one tractor and trailer bearing No.KA-13-TA-1827 and Ka-36-Ta-
6183 driven by its driver in a rash and negligent manner so as to
endanger human life and safety of others dashed against the
petitioners.
Due to the said impact, the petitioners fell down and
